subject: Promo bundle activation + request for granular billing cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah@launchforward.org>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Promo bundle activation + request for granular billing cadence

Hi Mateo / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Launch Forward is excited about Redwood's latency and cost controls. We have two asks as we prep legal and finance: 1) Can you activate the promo bundle credits (the cohort starter package you shared) on 2028-07-22 so it aligns with our orientation start? 2) Our finance team needs invoices that break down charges by run (per-invocation) rather than aggregated token buckets for our internal billing to sponsors.

Attached is a draft MOU from our side to formalize the milestone top-ups (MOU_LaunchForward_v1.pdf). The accelerator provides the credits to founders but requires a proforma invoice schedule so we can reimburse teams.

We'd like a short call tomorrow to lock the activation window and confirm any consumption caps you recommend.

Best,
Hannah Li
Program Director | Launch Forward Accelerator
H: 415-555-0192

Attachment: MOU_LaunchForward_v1.pdf (PDF, 248 KB)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Hannah Li <hannah@launchforward.org>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo bundle activation + request for granular billing cadence

Hi Hannah — great to hear, and thanks for the MOU.

Quick answers up front: we can activate the promo bundle on 2028-07-22 and set the cohort credits to be visible to your finance team as a line-item proforma. We don't normally bill per-invocation out of the box (our hosted product charges by tokens/embeddings units), but we can provide an export that maps invocations to token consumption and include a per-run conversion column so your accounting can attribute costs to each startup.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben will share a promo-pricing-sheet with the cohort-level limits and recommended safety caps.
- Monica will coordinate the proforma invoice template and the HubSpot billing note so your finance team has a clean record for reimbursements.
- Mateo to confirm activation window (we'll queue the credit allocation for 07/22 08:00 PT).

Can we do a 30-minute call today at 3pm PT? If that doesn't work, tomorrow morning also works.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
m: 650-555-0146

Attachment: promo-pricing-sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-19T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo bundle activation + request for granular billing cadence

Hannah — adding the pricing and suggested guardrails below.

Summary (see attached sheet for full table):
- Cohort Starter Promo: 250k tokens + 10k embedding units per startup for first 90 days.
- Milestone top-ups: two optional top-ups (50% of starter) on month-1 and month-2 subject to MOU triggers.
- Safety caps: default per-startup burst cap of 5k tokens/min; can bump to 10k temporarily by request.

For per-invocation accounting: we'll provide a CSV export each billing period that lists request_id, timestamp, endpoint, tokens_in, tokens_out, and a computed cost column. Your team can consume that and re-aggregate as they wish. If you need us to ship a per-run invoice we can add a downstream transformation step for an additional setup fee (one-time).

Suggested call: 3pm PT today — Mateo, can you lead the technical portion; Monica, can you confirm the invoice template items we can include?

- Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Startup Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: promo-pricing-sheet.xlsx

Thanks Ben — the export format looks ideal. We can't pay a one-time setup fee; our sponsors require the per-run billing in the proforma to be standard so reimbursements are straightforward. Is there flexibility to waive the setup fee for cohort partners? If Redwood can include the per-run invoice transform as part of the cohort package this quarter, we can commit to the 90-day starter for 120 startups in the upcoming cohort.

Also, small ask: can the activation be staged so founders get the first 25% of their credits immediately on 07/22 and the rest unlocked after their orientation (07/29) to mitigate accidental consumption?

Regards,
Hannah
